import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

from payhook.config import load_config, read_dotenv

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


class DoctorTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_secrets_hidden_and_sources(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            with open(os.path.join(tmp, ".env"), "w") as f:
                f.write('PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="sekret-token"\nexport PAYHOOK_REGION=us # c\n')
            env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("PAYHOOK_")}
            env.update(PYTHONPATH=ROOT, PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET="sekret-hook")
            r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "payhook", "doctor"], cwd=tmp,
                               capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn("sekret", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_REGION = us  [.env]", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT = 10  [default]", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET = (set, hidden)  [env]", r.stdout)

    def test_parser_edge_cases(self):
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".env", delete=False) as f:
            f.write("  export  A = 'x y'\nB=\"\"\nC=plain\nnoequals\nD=a#b\n")
        v = read_dotenv(f.name)
        self.assertEqual(v, {"A": "x y", "B": "", "C": "plain", "D": "a#b"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF
